purpose: De-identified index of operational dependencies, canonical owners, live-only contracts, and read-only verification surfaces.
freshness_rule: This map is navigation, not live status. Re-read the named verification surface before asserting current health.

components.boundary: Workspace changes are not live until the controlled release changes current. Do not retrofit a manifest into a legacy snapshot.
CRM remains the source of truth; Manager retains no business records.
The scheduled quick audit excludes Store and is not an external alert channel.

components.live_config_owner: Gmail and the main VPS relay unit
components.boundary: Gmail owns mail data; no message bodies or account state belong in this map.

components.live_config_owner: autostop24-db-backup.service and autostop24-db-backup.timer on the main VPS
components.boundary: Backup contents, names, and credentials are out of scope. Off-host replication is not implied.

components.live_config_owner: FST host and its container runtime
verification_surface: safe FST health readback through autostop-vpn-fst
components.boundary: Never expose profiles or credentials, and never route CRM through this VPN.

components.live_config_owner: managed-PC CLI and each enrolled endpoint
verification_surface: managed-pc status on an exact alias (tunnel and SSH)
components.boundary: A periodic doctor success does not establish endpoint availability; each endpoint requires a fresh exact-alias check before dispatch.

unassigned_dependencies.forbidden_assumption: Do not use FST, CRM, Gmail, or a customer system as backup storage without explicit authorization.
A local systemd or journal result is evidence, not owner notification.

requires: confirmed authoritative backup producer and schedule
restore objective and isolated restore drill
unassigned_dependencies.forbidden_assumption: A structurally readable local archive proves a current, complete, restorable FST configuration backup or alert path.
Do not treat a local doctor success or an off-hours disconnected endpoint as fleet availability.

requires: Windows-verifiable trust anchor outside the removable bundle
approved physical handoff and recovery procedure
unassigned_dependencies.forbidden_assumption: A manifest, signature, or public key carried in the same removable bundle proves Windows-side bundle provenance.
Do not backfill a manifest into a legacy snapshot or treat workspace revision as the active release.
